description: React component implementing an admin dashboard for managing bookings. Handles authentication, admin verification, booking display, status updates, and sign-in flows.

methods.name: AdminDashboard()
methods.description: Main React functional component for the admin dashboard interface.

methods.name: loadBookings
methods.description: Fetches and loads the bookings data from the database for admin users.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and admin notes for a specific booking, with fallback to RPC if direct update is restricted.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user and reloads the page.

methods.name: sendMagicLink
methods.description: Sends a login magic link to the provided email address.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a human-readable local date/time string.
